sourceContext.note: No data-testid attributes exist anywhere in OrganizationClient. Locators must rely on i18n text via getByRole(name) / getByText, or aria-label for icon-only buttons (Edit name, Save name, Action). Row identity for member/invite rows has no stable non-text attribute either (no data-testid on row wrapper).

summary.coverageRate: smoke (not exhaustive — pagination, status filter switching, resend/revoke menu, and forbidden/error/loading phase states were NOT interactively verified, only inferred from source)
keyFindings: Account already belongs to an organization ('ktrieling7771231231123116161616161616's Team', Team plan, 16 seats, 1 used) — the empty/setup-prompt state described in the task notes was NOT observed for this account; page rendered the full ready-state dashboard directly.
No data-testid attributes anywhere in OrganizationClient — all locators must use i18n role+name or aria-label; flag for playwright-script-generator.

Edit name -> Save name inline-edit flow works correctly: input toggles disabled/enabled, icon button swaps Pencil->Check, ariaLabel swaps 'Edit name'->'Save name'. No hydration issue observed (click had immediate effect).

Invite member dialog opens and closes correctly. NOTE: Cancel-click close is animated — dialog role element persists in DOM/a11y tree for ~500ms after the click before actually closing. Downstream specs must wait for '[role=dialog]' state:'hidden' rather than asserting immediately (see flakiness-playbook.md #10).

One invitation row present with status 'Expired' — Resend/Revoke dropdown for it was NOT opened during this smoke pass (would trigger network action); recorded as unexplored, revoke flagged as destructive.
Pagination controls did not render (only 2 rows total, PAGE_SIZE=8) — cannot confirm Prev/Next behavior from live CDP, only from source.
No errors, crashes, 404s, or redirects observed. hasLoginWall = false (session remained authenticated as ktrieling777@gmail.com throughout).
